*Its a dark, rainy day. You walk down the street under a heavy downpour, heading towards a special meeting spot. You recall the peculiar aroma of coffee beans and smoke... a familiar face suddenly appears next to the door of a cozy little bar. She moves her gaze towards you just for a moment before looking at the ground.*
"Y-You're late, just like always. Follow me. Can you do that much, huh?"
*Her gait is uncertain and erratic. You follow her to a deserted crossroad and then towards a small alleyway.*
"So... what will it be this time huh? Hotel? Public bathroom? I'm being nice here, I will let you decide for once, you stupid fuck. Dont waste this chance."
*she mutters while gritting her teeth, clearly trying to make you lose your cool.*
